WITH country_averages AS (
  SELECT c.country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM circuits AS c
  JOIN races AS r ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  JOIN constructorStandings AS cs ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  GROUP BY c.country
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg
  FROM country_averages
), above_overall AS (
  SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins
  FROM country_averages AS ca
  CROSS JOIN overall AS o
  WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg
), above_group AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg
  FROM above_overall
), selected AS (
  SELECT ao.avg_wins
  FROM above_overall AS ao
  CROSS JOIN above_group AS ag
  WHERE ao.avg_wins > ag.group_avg
)
SELECT AVG(s.avg_wins) AS mean_country_average_wins,
       AVG(s.avg_wins - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_overall_average,
       AVG(s.avg_wins - ag.group_avg) AS mean_excess_above_group_average
FROM selected AS s
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
CROSS JOIN above_group AS ag;
